text:
carla: heads-up from support — TileCo reports a big behavior change after last night's model rollout. previously polite clarifications now return incorrect factual claims. sample request and response included. request_id=rc_9f3a, customer says ~40% of responses are broken :frowning:
priya: can you paste the exact prompt + resp? also which model variant are they hitting?
carla: pasted below. model: redwood-text-2.4-quant, endpoint: /v1/generate, region: us-west1. snippet:
```
prompt: "What is the release date of Product X?"
response: "Product X was released in 2015 by Company Y."
```
But Product X released in 2021. multiple customers seeing similar timeline hallucinations after deploy.
ben: noted. deploy-bot shows a rollout at 2024-11-05T03:10Z of compiler-kernel v3.1 + model bundle redwood-text-2.4. I pushed a sanity check, but might have missed this output regression.
deploy-bot: deploy redwood-text-2.4 -> us-west1 completed, canary 10% -> 100% (2024-11-05T03:10Z).
leo: oncall here — impact looks like user-facing factual errors, not infrastructure failures. latency OK. need a mitigation plan: rollback or config change?
dave: Product agrees rollback to 2.3 if it's quick. we should limit blast radius and notify affected customers.
priya: quick repro attempt: ran same prompt against 2.3 -> returns correct 2021. against 2.4 -> incorrect 2015. looks reproducible. attaching run ids.
ben: suspect change in tokenization/decoder sampler after kernel bump. if kernel selects different top-k sampling defaults for small prompts, could explain shift. Can we temporarily force deterministic sampling at the routing layer? e.g., set temperature=0 for affected customers?
carla: TileCo cannot tolerate variable answers — they want same deterministic factual outputs. They asked for rollback ASAP.
leo: ops checklist: 1) prepare rollback to redwood-text-2.3 for prod 2) create support note for TileCo 3) monitor error rate. I'll coordinate.
ben: rollback plan: patch routing table to pin model->2.3 for prod region. quick command we use:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routes/pin 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-text-2","version":"2.3","region":"us-west1"}'
```
leo: I'll run that in 10m, will notify here. also spinning up a canary with 2.3 pinned for 5% first.
dave: assign owners: leo=rollback exec, priya=regression RCA, ben=runtime postmortem, carla=customer comms.
priya: will start a quick diff on logits and kv cache outputs. early hypothesis: changed EOS handling in kernel v3.1.
ops-bot: scheduled rollback job 82412 pending approval.
ben: one safety: we should snapshot metrics (quality, hallucination rate) and trace IDs before rollback. ben will export CSV to /tmp/hallucination_summ_1813456789.csv
carla: drafting message to TileCo: "We detected an unintended behavioral regression after a model rollout and are rolling back to the prior model version. You may see request results revert within ~5-15 minutes. We'll follow up with RCA." ok to send?
dave: yes send now, mark as high priority. mention SRE & PM.
carla: sent to TileCo and updated ticket with rollback plan.
leo: rolling back now. patching routing table...
leo: canary pinned 5% -> monitoring logs.
ben: watching sample run ids — first canary responses look correct for the test prompts.
leo: increasing to 50% now.
leo: full rollback to 2.3 in us-west1 completed at 1813460200.
deploy-bot: rollback job 82412 completed, routing table updated.
carla: TileCo confirms their sample prompts now return expected answers.
dave: good. next steps: priya to run detailed RCA, ben to run performance and kernel regression test, ops to add hard guard for future kernel/model compatibility.
priya: will open ticket ENG-REG-412 with logs, diff, and repro harness by EOD.
ben: creating postmortem draft, will include mitigation framework (canary thresholds, auto-pin on hallucination spike).
leo: closing incident thread here after we ensure no other regions impacted. adding alert to watch for similar events. :white_check_mark:
carla: marking customer ticket resolved pending RCA. thanks team.
